MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products? (1 mark)

   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)

   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

17. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)

19. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

21. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

22. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen
